text:
Nora (PM): quick sync - new idea for the preflight host list: compact rows, inline status, but keyboard-first actions (no hidden hover-only affordances). figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder 'compact-hosts-kb'

Zed (Design): thumbs up to keyboard-first. propose: rows show name, short status, meta (latency • probe type). make the expand control a visible caret button with aria-label 'Show details for <host>'.

Hiro (Eng): implementation note: we'll return probe metadata and a 'retryAllowed' flag per host. client should show a small spinner on retry and 'Last checked: 22s ago'.

Lina (Accessibility): a11y rules: rows must be in tab order, caret button must be reachable via keyboard and have aria-expanded. when details open, move focus to the first action (Retry). ESC collapses and returns focus to the caret. announce final summary only.

Nora (PM): copy question: row label options: 'Unreachable' vs "Can't reach host" vs 'No response'. which is clearest?

Zed (Design): use "Can't reach host" for the row. in the detail panel show 'No response (timeout)' with more context. keeps row concise and conversational.

Hiro (Eng): for commands, include a single-line copyable snippet like: `nc -vz 10.2.3.4 8800`. copy button should be icon-only but have aria-label 'Copy command for 10.2.3.4'.

Lina (Accessibility): ensure the copy button announces success: 'Command copied to clipboard' via a polite live region. avoid relying on color for status; always include icon + text.

Zed (Design): visual tone: avoid red banners. show neutral summary: 'Checks done — 5 reachable, 2 need attention' with amber when partial failures. add a small 'Show failures only' toggle that switches to stacked cards for debugging.

Hiro (Eng): edge-case: flaky hosts. please cap retries to 3 attempts client-side and display cooldown: 'Retry disabled — try again in 28s'. server will also enforce backoff. show countdown but update it only every 5s to avoid verbosity.

Lina (Accessibility): announce the cooldown state once when it appears: 'Retry disabled for 28 seconds'. make tooltip content accessible (aria-describedby). countdown updates shouldn't be announced every tick.

Nora (PM): UX for failures: an inline collapsed card under the row with one-line cause, a recommended step, and a 'Retry probe' button + 'Contact support' link. Keep raw logs hidden behind 'Show logs' to reduce noise.

Zed (Design): microcopy tweak: change KB phrase from 'run from a machine in the same network' to 'run from a host in the same VPC or VLAN'. it's clearer for on-prem customers.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview build finished — https://deploy/preview/1357 (staging)

Hiro (Eng): QA ask: include a test where a host flips state quickly so we can validate focus stability and live region behavior.

Nora (PM): thanks all. I'll update the mocks with visible caret buttons, row copy change, per-host cooldown UI, accessible copy feedback, and neutral summary. posting updated figma + preview when ready.
